paper_title: Dark Matter from Axion Strings with Adaptive Mesh Refinement
coupling_convention: f_a in GeV vs m_a in eV
notes: This is a cosmological/simulation prediction (not an experimental exclusion). Using AMR simulations of the axion string network, the authors predict the post-inflation QCD axion mass that gives the observed DM abundance: m_a in (40,180) micro-eV, corresponding to f_a in (3.1e10, 1.4e11) GeV. For the scale-invariant spectrum (q=1) they predict m_a = 65 +/- 6 micro-eV. Data points encode the endpoints of the predicted band as (m_a[eV], f_a[GeV]).
